high_level_description: The image depicts a TED Talk event taking place on a stage with a circular red carpet. The backdrop is a large, dark blue curtain with the iconic red "TED" logo prominently displayed in the center. On the stage, there are two individuals seated in armchairs facing each other. The person on the left appears to be the host or interviewer, dressed in a dark suit jacket over a white shirt and jeans, with green sneakers. The person on the right seems to be the guest speaker, wearing a light blue blazer over a white shirt and jeans, paired with white sneakers.
